comment: Widescreen (widescreen.c, fullwidth.S), player camera control (camera.c) the QOL options (qol.c: encounter rate, battle rewards, battle speed) and the Dreamcast music (dcmusic.c). Every 'bl target' in the DOL's code is rewritten to 'bl to' (redirect_calls), or only at the listed site or sites (redirect_sites); gamepatch.py fails if a site doesn't hold the expected call.
